reviews.text: Paw Basics is more than a great pet store. Kimbie and her team consistently show up for local and surrounding-area rescues when help is needed most—quietly, generously, and without being asked. That kind of community support is rare, and it’s a big reason we keep going there for quality foods and treats. The selection is excellent, but the way they take care of the animals who don’t have homes yet is what really sets them apart.
Thank you so much!!

Love! Love! Love this store and the knowledge of their team! We had a VERY picky Bernese Mountain Dog eater and now he waits eagerly for his food and levels his bowl. They have tons of clean quality brands and are honest about value versus quality. Go here! It’s so fun just to roam and  people even take their fur babies. Love Paw Basics!!
They were very helpful and knowledgeable  about the peoducts.

I love how knowledgeable everyone is to help revise my pup. He was dying. After 2nd and 3rd opinion from different vets and many medications and hospitalization I didn’t know where else to go and turn. They all want me to start preparing my heart to euthanize him. I was advised to go to Paw Basics to get some food to see how he reacts to the food. After the first meal, his life was completely turned around. Paw Basics is a treasure.

My 10 year old precious Shih Tzu, Bella, has recently been diagnosed with extremely high liver enzymes. As a dog mom, this has been incredibly emotional and stressful. We have tried prescription diets, Balance It recipes, homemade meals, and so many different options, but Bella has been very picky. During her follow up appointment, she had lost weight, and the vet stressed how important it was to simply get her to eat.

While searching for another food option, I decided to stop by Paw Basics in San Antonio, and I truly cannot say enough wonderful things about my experience. From the moment I walked in, I was greeted warmly and asked if I needed help. I explained Bella’s situation, and the owner took the time to walk me through different options, provided samples of several hepatic foods to try, encouraged me to stay positive, and genuinely listened to my concerns with so much patience, compassion, and understanding.

Sometimes when you are worried about your pet, you just need someone who truly cares, and today I felt that. Knowing someone else cared about Bella as much as I do meant the world to me. I also discussed changing my cats’ diets and felt welcomed the entire time. I am so grateful I decided to stop in because Paw Basics has absolutely earned a lifelong customer. I can’t believe I live only minutes away and never knew about this amazing place until now.

THANK YOU Paw Basics!!!, for your kindness, patience, compassion, and for being a listening ear when I truly needed one today. You made a difficult day a little lighter for both Bella and me.
Thank you so much for the 5-stars!!

Paw Basics is one of those places that makes you want to shop local. Every visit, I’m greeted with kindness, and the staff is always happy to help and genuinely knows their stuff. They’ve guided me through food options a few times, and my Doberman is still loving the one they recommended. Great store, great people! Highly recommend.
Great selection of pet food, excellent friendly customer service! 5 stars!

This place is nirvana for me and my dogs!! I am so welcomed every time I walk in, even when it’s super busy. Kimbie, Robyn, Stacy and Alix are so kind, helpful and uber knowledgeable!
They even remember what my babies eat and treats they love! They let me wander the store and even hang out and chat! They only stock food and treats and supplements that they have researched and trust. I’m crazy for Paw Basics!!!

This place is amazing. They are so knowledgeable about everything for your pets. They will even special order food if your dogs have specific needs. They have helped my dogs so much by getting them on the correct food. Best pet store in San Antonio by far!! They have a huge selection of raw food as well as Kibble and treats. Also my dogs are obsessed with coming here!! I make it a point to bring them every few weeks… They Are always given pup cups, and treats, and lots of loving pets by the employees and owners!!!

The worst customer service in all of San Antonio ever, and I've lived here my whole life. I go to this store consistently, only because they are the only ones in the area that sale the brand of dog food that I get. They never greet us or say a word to us and I consistently spend over $100 every time. There are only 3 stores in San Antonio that sell the brand of dog food that I purchase and unfortunately for me, they are the closest to me. I don't understand how you can be animal people but still be terrible people. If there isn't a specific brand that only this store sells, avoio this place unless you want to be in a super awkward and uncomfortable space. I don't understand how this place has good reviews, because after visiting this place every other week for a year, the horrible customer service is absolutely consistent.
When I'm near Broadway, I visit Fifi and Fidos, great customer service and selection. The nicest people you will ever meet! The staff is extremely knowledgeable and more than happy to share the knowledge

Reply:
The reason you only see a check in 5 times in 8 months is because your staff doesn’t bother to ask us for our information when we check out. I did the review this week because this was the first time your staff has spoken to us at all and I was floored that y’all actually talk. If I wasn’t receptive to being asked if I needed help it was because after all this time of going into your store and now you want to speak to me, I was insulted. As far as the check out, one of the employees that day just asked  for our phone number and what package of frozen treats I had chosen, duck hearts, and rung us up from our side of the counter, while the the other employee was trying to figure out the Hulu password to log into the account on the TV screen. Please do not try and insinuate that I am a liar, the customer service I have witnessed consistently is horrific and like I already stated, the only reason I return is because the brand of dog food I purchase for my babies is extremely difficult to find. I tell every fur baby parent that I meet that your store carries great product but the level of customer service that your store carries leaves so much room for improvement, to say the very least. I can genuinely say I dislike going into your store, it’s always an awkward experience and hope that another store opens near by that sells the same quality products that my fur babies get
You want to make it up to me?!? How about we just start with basic customer service. For example just greeting. Super simple and extremely human. It just seems like you know you will continue to make money because you carry great product so why bother being welcoming and graceful. It takes very little effort to be friendly and welcoming, and it’s a shame that every visit is awkward and uncomfortable.
Just an FYI, I saw your post on Facebook trying to get unfounded sympathy from your followers, or maybe retaliation for me being honest, but it is what is and I stand firm on my review. I’m giving this feedback so that your business can improve, not to hurt your feelings or “take the wind out of your sails”. And It’s obvious if I’m willing to spend money consistently in an establishment that I feel unwelcomed in for my babies, they are well cared for, no need for sympathy.
I’ve posted our conversation(review/posts) on multiple social platforms and welcome and invite for you to respond.

Could not LOVE this store more!! The owner and staff truly care about their customers and their fur babies and it makes the world of a difference!! My sweet girl is a picky eater and they have gone above and beyond trying to help me find the food that works the best for her. Love this store!!
I am always greeted and asked if I need help. I love how welcoming the store is to our 4 legged friends. My puppers love coming and making their own selections in the toy section!

Truly the friendliest people around. I love bringing my pup to the store with me because they shower her with attention. Thank you Kimbie and team for all your hard work building such a wonderful small business.
Super knowledgeable and friendly staff!

Paw Basics is hands down the best pet store out there. We travel several hours to purchase food, supplements, treats and all sorts of goodies probably monthly and have done so for years. Kim and the staff are all extremely knowledgeable in pet nutrition and have helped me tremendously with my allergy prone and chronically ill German shepherd. She’s up to date with the latest news in the pet food world and always tells me if a change may affect my dogs. They know us well and are always kind and welcoming. We love Paw Basics!

The absolute best customer service I’ve ever received in a pet store. They treat their customers like family here and the dogs even better! I am so grateful that PawBasics exists! My favorite place to treat my pups!! 10/10

As someone who’s shopped at EVERY other pet store here in San Antonio this place is a gem! The whole staff is amazing. From their knowledgeable suggestions to their warm welcoming attitude! I will forever support these wonderful people ! Thank you for providing my pack the best nutrition and making every trip enjoyable
Definitely the GO TO for specialty foods and more for your fur babies. The owners are so knowledgeable as well. Love it here.
The staff was very helpful and friendly. And their prices are very reasonable
Thank you!!!
Always love the friendly atmosphere and our food is always in stock !
Local pet store with good selection of high quality food and products. If you're looking for a particular type of diet or supplement they probably have it. Always friendly customer service.
The only pet store I get my dogs food from! Love that they carry Carna4. :-)
Sweet experience.  The service is amazing and the person who helped us was great giving us recommendations.
Excellent service! Very knowledgeable. Answered all of my questions and pointed me in the right direction regarding my dog.

I ABSOLUTELY recommend this place 100%!!! The staff is EXTREMELY friendly, helpful, and knowledgeable!! Whenever we are in San Antonio we stop by to pick up items for our dog and cat. They have reasonable prices, fresh items, and know about the products they sell.  What I appreciate the most is that they recognize and remember that we are coming in from out of town! Wow, great customer service! Bonus - they offer a first responders discount! Greatly appreciated! Swing by! The staff is top notch!

Excellent resource for pet parents feeding raw, home cooked, or as close to home cooked food vs commercial dog food. Wide variety of healthy feeding options here. Friendly, knowledgeable staff, so great to have them close by!
A nice shop and we'll stocked up but the mark up on prices is a bit to much for me

We’ve been going to Paw Basics for approximately two years now and we are so grateful that we found a specialty pet food store with knowledgeable and friendly staff. Every time my husband goes in for food they remember who we are and their recommendations are always on point, such gems!
Thank you for the 5 stars!
Healthy dog food heaven!
Thank you for the 5 stars!!

I always try to put as much money back into the local economy as possible and shop local- but Paw Basics is just special. Even if I didn't shop the way I do, I'd still go because everyone who works there cares about every single person who comes through the door and their furry friends more than anything else. I would take a bullet for each and every person there. I have a cat with some special needs, and I've always been able to ask questions about products or alternative diet things with open arms. All of their products are absolutely fantastic and I can tell they make sure what they sell is safe for your pet. I absolutely love my little trips to Paw Basics; this place is truly a gem. I am humbled to have such wonderful people in this community!

Wonderful experience. I have a pomsky & it’s hard to find a good groomer for him. I have tried so many places & had worse experiences. She knows what she’s doing & her prices are reasonable. My dog was shedding so much but after she groomed & deshedded him, OMG! he’s not shedding at all.
The best place for grooming❤️

I can’t say enough good things about this place. As a normally online shopper, I’m so thankful to have a local store with all the specialty items I need for my IBD dog. Brands like Adored Beast, Dr. Judy Morgan, OC Raw, kin & kind, Green Juju, Answers, Dr. Harvey’s, etc. My dog gets the best welcome here and loves sniffing around the store. The team all know my girl’s food restrictions and will offer her safe treats, which is so sweet. You guys really get the importance of using food and quality products to heal our beloved companions vs just treating symptoms.

Paw Basics is like a little Food Boutique for your pet, they have specialty food like goat 🐐 milk for your pets, also natural ways of healing your pet.
Amazing Place with amazing food like duck 🦆 meat for pets also AMAZING 🤩 …
Absolutely my favorite place to buy my pets food!

Paw Basics is awesome! I really appreciate being able to shop for quality cat food and treats so close to where I live! Also greatly appreciate the thoughtfulness of the selections and EXCELLENT variety!  Too often it can feel like cats are just an afterthought to dogs, but not at Paw Basics!  Added bonus, all of the staff are friendly, knowledgeable and helpful. They are FANTASTIC at answering questions and sharing information without being condescending or judgmental. ! Thank you so much for providing the area with better, healthier options for our fur and purr family  members. I highly recommend this place.
Awesome local pet store that is knowledgeable about our pets needs. Staff is friendly and supports vets. Nail trimmings are great on Sundays.
I love the selection of higher quality dog food and treats and the customer service is wonderful!
First time visitor!  Fantastic experience getting our dog's nails trimmed.  Everyone was so nice.  Very gourmet in the world of dog's and cats.  Will definitely be back.
Kimbie has helped our animals for almost 5 years. From allergies to food sensitivities, you can not ask for a more knowledgeable group to help you choose the proper diet and products for your pets.

I LOVE this store! Easily the best place in SA for all your pets needs. The staff are incredibly nice, knowledgeable and helpful. The carry the best food with high-quality ingredients. My dog and I highly recommend you check this place out!
The best always!
Great selection of food for unique taste and medical conditions. Terrific help too. They have former veterinary experience and can help with a lot of questions.
Thank you for the 5 stars!

I’m so happy to see a pet store selling food with good ingredients. I was able to find a food made with European standards, which bans a lot of additives that America allows. The staff was very knowledgeable and kept my dogs specific needs in mind.
Wonderful pet boutique and great selection of food.  They order my cats' favorite frozen raw food, Primal Pronto (the small quick thaw cubes) and their personalized service is second to none.
